page.title: Best Phone With a Screen on the Back (2026): NUU B40 5G vs razr and Rugged Picks
page.h1: Best phone with a screen on the back
page.desc: The NUU B40 5G is the only non-rugged phone with a rear screen sold new in the US: a 1.6-inch AMOLED for main-camera selfies. It runs on T-Mobile networks only and has no NFC.
page.intro:
Short answer. The best phone with a screen on the back is the NUU B40 5G ({buy:nuu-b40-5g}): a 1.6-inch AMOLED screen beside the 64 MP main camera, so you can frame selfies with the main camera. It also has a 6.7-inch 120 Hz main screen and 8 GB / 256 GB. It is the only non-rugged phone with a rear screen that we found sold new in the US. Xiaomi's 17 Pro has a larger one but is sold only in China. The catch: it works only on T-Mobile and carriers that use T-Mobile's network (Mint, Metro), it has no NFC for tap-to-pay, and NUU publishes no update schedule.

If you are on Verizon or AT&T, pay with your phone, or want the best selfies, get a Motorola razr (2026) flip instead. Its 3.6-inch outer screen does the same job, but it costs far more. For a job site, the Doogee S200 is a rugged phone with a 1.32-inch round rear screen, an IP68/IP69K rating and a 10,100 mAh battery.

cells.networks: Unlocked; also sold by Verizon and T-Mobile

page.after:
What owners and reviewers complain about

  • Updates (B40). This was the most common complaint. All 3 reviews collected by Criticaster list limited software updates as a con. Neowin reported that its review phone got no update for about two months, and NUU said it was still working out its update plan. NUU's site lists no OS or security update schedule.
  • The rear screen is small. It came up in 3 of 3 reviews. At 1.6 inches it is good for framing a selfie, checking the time or skipping a song. You can't use apps on it the way you can on a razr's outer screen.
  • Missing basics. NUU's own comparison table shows no NFC and no headphone jack. NUU lists no water-resistance rating and no microSD slot.
  • Carrier limits. NUU lists only T-Mobile as the B40's operator. Check that your carrier runs on T-Mobile's network before you buy.
  • Macro camera. 2 of 3 reviews call the 2 MP macro camera useless.

Which one by need

  • Main-camera selfies on a budget, on T-Mobile, Mint or Metro: NUU B40 5G ({buy:nuu-b40-5g}). No other non-rugged phone sold new in the US has a rear screen.
  • Verizon or AT&T, tap-to-pay, a bigger outer screen: Motorola razr (2026). Its 3.6-inch cover screen works as a viewfinder for the main cameras, it has NFC, and it is rated IP48. The razr+ (2026) has a 4-inch cover screen.
  • Work sites and outdoors: Doogee S200, with a 1.32-inch round rear screen, IP68/IP69K, NFC and a 10,100 mAh battery. Confirm that it supports your carrier first.
  • A NUU phone without a rear screen that works on Verizon and AT&T: NUU X10 5G ({buy:nuu-x10-5g}). It has NFC, a headphone jack and a microSD slot.

Not recommended

  • The B40 on Verizon or AT&T, or if you pay by phone. NUU doesn't list it for those networks, and it has no NFC.
  • Importing a Xiaomi 17 Pro or 17 Pro Max. The rear screens are larger, but these phones are sold only in China. That means no US retail channel and no US warranty.
